items.title: Pentair Investor Alert: Johnson Fistel Reviews Potential Claims for Shareholders
items.summary: Johnson Fistel is investigating Pentair plc (NYSE: PNR) on behalf of investors who suffered losses following the company's July 14, 2026 disclosure of a dramatic miss on sales guidance. Pentair projected second-quarter sales would decline 17% year-over-year instead of growing 1%, citing unexpected Pool channel inventory destocking of approximately $170 million. The company also slashed full-year guidance from 2-4% growth to 4-7% decline, and reduced EPS guidance from $5.30-$5.40 to $4.60-$4.80. The stock declined approximately 22% in premarket trading following the announcement, and the company's CFO departed on July 10, 2026.

items.title: Hagens Berman Investigating Potential Claims on Behalf of Investors in Pentair plc
items.summary: National shareholder rights firm Hagens Berman is investigating Pentair plc for potential securities law violations following the company's July 14, 2026 announcement of a significant earnings miss, with Q2 2026 sales falling to approximately $930 million versus forecasted $1.14 billion. The investigation focuses on potentially undisclosed and unsustainable sales practices with distributors that may have artificially inflated prior revenues. The situation was compounded by the unexpected resignation of CFO Nicholas Brazis after only four months in the role, raising concerns about internal controls and revenue recognition. Pentair subsequently slashed full-year 2026 guidance, triggering a sharp decline in share price and substantial shareholder losses.
